text: Totally 5 star medical clinic in Jomtien Beach. They have the most caring and kind staff you could ask for. You aren't a patient here, you are a human. Go here.

I visited the clinic complaining of tonsillitis. The doctor listened to me, examined me, and prescribed treatment. In addition to medications, he prescribed antibiotic injections every day.
I paid for the medications and for the appointment with a truly professional and attentive doctor.
The clinic is new, clean, and comfortable!

When I arrived the next day to get the prescribed injection, I was told to see a general practitioner. They didn't tell me it would be a full appointment and would cost extra.

The conversation went something like this:
-What's hurting you?
-You have it all on your computer, nothing has changed, but I'm already feeling better. I came to get my prescribed injection.
-Okay, you can go get the injection; the door is over there.

If I'd known it was a paid appointment, I wouldn't have spent two minutes there in this pointless conversation; I would have asked questions about my health. I have some related issues, but I planned to see the doctor myself after finishing the prescribed antibiotic treatment and then return for a follow-up examination once the acute infection had cleared up.

I'd also like to thank the doctor and leave a good review, but unfortunately, they only gave me a receipt that didn't include his name and no information about diagnosis.
I also liked the staff and nurses; they were very responsive and attentive.

In conclusion, it would be much easier for me to buy the exact same medication with the same dosage in tablet form at the pharmacy than to pay for a pointless consultation every day when I'm already prescribed injections.

Perhaps this was a system error, as the clinic is new and the workflow processes may not be in place. I hope management sees my review.

In any case, I'll give them 5 stars, but be careful if you go here: ask about the cost of all services before they do anything, otherwise you might get a completely different bill at the checkout.
